title: Oven Roasted Mexican Beef Kidney Tacos
description: A cultured and creamy Mexican dish featuring beef kidney and rest-meat, perfect for a date-night dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced beef kidney and diced rest-meat.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, diced chipotle peppers, ground cumin, and ground coriander to the bowl and mix well.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes.
While the meat is roasting, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Once the meat is done, assemble the tacos by spooning the meat mixture onto a tortilla and topping with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy.
